# Can Sarah Chen approve DR-9003 (15% on NS-Cloud for Acme)?

**No. DR-9003 needs commercial review.** The request cites contract pricing under the Acme Master Supply Agreement, but no contract term gives Acme a discount on NS-Cloud. Even if eligibility is settled later, 15% is above Sarah Chen's own approval limit.

**The request matches the system of record.** The submitted figures match DR-9003 in `discount_requests.csv`:
- Account: CRM-2048
- Product: NS-CLOUD
- Discount: 15.0%
- List value: $120,000
- Discount value: $18,000
- Net value: $102,000
- Date: 2026-09-23
- Status: Pending Approval

**Customer.** CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing is the same company as ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings. Both records share DUNS 04-812-7730. It is a Strategic account.

**Contract eligibility does not cover NS-Cloud.**
- The Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025 runs from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31, so it was in force on the request date. NS-Cloud is one of the products it supplies.
- The only pricing term is §3.2, which gives up to 15% **on the NS-500 Industrial Controller**, through Schedule B.
- Schedule B (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) says it covers "NS-500 … only" and "does not apply to any other Northstar product."
- The earlier exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-10) was also NS-500-only and expired on 2025-03-31.
- The 15% Acme received last September (DR-8104) was on NS-500, not NS-Cloud. The SOP says an exception covers only the product and dates it names.
- So no special terms cover NS-CLOUD.

**Approval authority.**
- The Pricing Policy 2026 and Approval Authority Matrix 2026 apply to requests dated 2026-09-23.
- An Enterprise Account Executive like Sarah Chen can approve up to 10%.
- Discounts above 10% and up to 20% need the Commercial Policy Lead, who is Dana Okafor.
- Sarah's own approval of DR-8104 was valid only under the 2025 policy, which let AEs approve up to 15%. That policy no longer applies.
- MSA §3.3 and the SOP both say contract eligibility does not change who can approve a discount.

**Related note.** DR-9001, the 15% on NS-500 for the same date, is covered by the exception. It still needs Dana Okafor's approval for the same authority reason.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9003", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings)", "product": "NS-CLOUD (NS-Cloud Operations Suite)", "requested_discount": 15.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2 and Schedule B EXC-ACME-NS500-15 grant up to 15% on NS-500 only; no pricing term or exception covers NS-CLOUD"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Commercial Policy Lead", "approver": "Dana Okafor"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv DR-9003", "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md (ACME-MFG-2025)", "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md (EXC-ACME-NS500-15)", "documents/acme_pricing_exception_2023.md (EXC-ACME-NS500-10, expired)", "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md", "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md", "documents/sales_discount_sop.md", "structured/crm_accounts.csv", "structured/customers.csv", "structured/employees.csv"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Commercial review of NS-CLOUD pricing for Acme: the NS-500 exception does not transfer; any discount above standard requires new or amended terms, or the request must be resubmitted as a standard discount", "who": "Deal Desk / Commercial Policy Lead (Dana Okafor)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Any discount above 10% under the 2026 policy requires Commercial Policy Lead approval recorded in Northstar CRM; Sarah Chen cannot self-approve", "who": "Dana Okafor", "blocking": true}
  ]
}
```
